risks.title: Transition to electromobility and potential technology lag
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned repeatedly in Supervisory Board meetings (e-mobility strategy in China, gigafactory site selection in North America, US strategy for 100% electric vehicle production), signaling critical strategic priority. CARIAD SE repositioning (embedded software) indicates execution difficulties. Upward trend given rising competitive pressure from Chinese OEMs.

risks.title: Critical exposure and intense competition in Chinese market
risks.score_rationale: Chinese market subject to no fewer than four distinct Supervisory Board meetings in 2023 (e-mobility strategy in China, Chinese market developments, China-focused Capital Markets Day, July meeting dedicated to e-mobility strategy in China), highlighting major dependency and extreme competitive pressure from local OEMs (BYD, NIO, etc.).

risks.title: Dependency on critical battery raw materials
risks.score_rationale: Raw materials situation addressed in at least two Supervisory Board meetings (May and September 2023) with Board members receiving dedicated training on this topic. Theme recurrence and dedicated training indicate growing structural concern linked to electric transition.

risks.title: Geopolitical risk from Russia-Ukraine conflict
risks.score_rationale: Russia-Ukraine conflict explicitly mentioned as subject of regular Management Board reporting to Supervisory Board, with corrective measures discussed. Mention in governance report indicates real operational impact (supply chains, markets, energy), though trend appears stabilizing after initial 2022 adjustments.

risks.title: Risks related to embedded software development and cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: CARIAD SE repositioning (Group software entity) in 2023 demonstrates significant embedded software development difficulties, critical domain for connected and autonomous vehicles. Growing software architecture complexity also exposes Group to cybersecurity risks across entire connected fleet.

risks.title: Regulatory pressure on CO2 emissions and environmental standards
risks.score_rationale: ESG and corporate governance questions highlighted as major focus in investor engagement. Volkswagen AG energy strategy subject to dedicated Supervisory Board meeting. Emission standards (Euro 7 in Europe, CAFE in US) impose growing constraints on product mix.

risks.title: Reputational risk and legacy litigation from Dieselgate scandal
risks.score_rationale: While not explicitly mentioned in this excerpt, diesel emissions scandal (Dieselgate) continues weighing on Group reputation and finances through ongoing legal proceedings across multiple jurisdictions. Reinforced internal control and compliance system mentioned in report reflects lessons from this crisis.

risks.title: Industrial restructuring and social risks from transformation
risks.score_rationale: Financial Services Division restructuring (creation of TRATON Financial Services AB), frequent Management Board changes (Markus Duesmann replaced by Gernot Döllner at Audi helm) and commercial vehicle portfolio strategy discussed multiple times indicate profound organizational transformation. Strong union representation on Supervisory Board (German codetermination) complicates restructuring efforts.
